title: Ourania SMP
description: Ourania SMP is a cozy survival Minecraft server running on 1.21.8+ that allows both Java and Bedrock players to have fun, explore, make friends and build whatever they like!
body:
![Ourania Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5d973be136e71f9bf47293a07e3befc511e8f25c.png)

Whether you want to PvP, Build, explore or make friends, Ourania is the place for you!
Our server is mainly focused on trying to offer a cozy place for players to enjoy playing and doing whatever they like with a lot of freedom 

Our community is open to new players over 14+
We are friendly and open to suggestions on how to improve our server and its features!

The server is running on 1.21.8+
Both Java and Bedrock players can join the server
- IP: **ouraniasmp.modrinth.gg**
- Port: **30752**

What we offer you:
* Custom content (mob drops, block drops and much more coming in the future)
* Cosmetics (hats, wings, chat tags, particles...)
* Monthly events with collectibles (Easter, Halloween etc...)
* The world expands over time and resets after each season ends! (a season lasts around a year)  
**(We are currently undergoing Season 1!)**

Join us and help us shape the future of the SMP!
